fields.description: Flow Agent to run when this trigger fires.
fields.label: Agent

fields.description: What kind of event fires this trigger.
fields.label: Event

fields.description: Run this trigger's tool calls without asking for approval. Required for unattended triggers — otherwise the run pauses waiting for a confirmation.
fields.label: Auto Approve Tool Calls

fields.description: Run the agent as this user, so its tools act with a defined, least-privilege permission scope. Defaults to the trigger's owner when empty. Prefer a purpose-scoped service user over a full administrator.
fields.label: Run As

fields.description: DocType whose events fire this trigger.
fields.label: Target DocType

fields.description: Which lifecycle event of the target DocType fires this trigger.
fields.label: Doc Event

fields.description: Standard 5-field cron, e.g. '0 9 * * 5' for every Friday 09:00.
fields.label: Cron Expression

fields.description: Last time this scheduled trigger fired. Set by the system.
fields.label: Last Fired At

fields.description: Optional Python condition; the trigger fires only if it is truthy. A single expression (e.g. doc.status == "Open"), or a multi-line script that must assign the verdict to a variable named result. Runs in the server-script sandbox with doc in scope for DocType events. Requires server scripts to be enabled in the bench configuration; without it the condition is treated as not met and the trigger does not fire.
fields.label: Condition

fields.description: Jinja template rendered into the agent input. doc and now are in scope, e.g. Summarize {{ doc.doctype }} {{ doc.name }} and suggest next steps: {{ doc.description }}
fields.label: Prompt Template
